membership.heading: Request Membership Consideration
membership.lead: Membership in the CEO Elite Circle is by invitation and consideration only.
membership.body: Tell us who you are and what you are working on. Someone from the Circle will read it, and you will hear back either way.
membership.note: Fields are not yet wired up — the application questions are still being confirmed. The button below opens the full request page.

application.heading: Apply for Membership
application.lead: One application, whichever category you are considered for.
application.body: Category is decided during consideration rather than chosen at the outset, so an approximate answer is fine here.
application.note: Fields are not yet wired up — the application questions are still being confirmed. The button below opens the full request page.

pillar.heading: Enquire about this pillar
pillar.lead: Questions about how a pillar works in practice are welcome before any question of membership.
pillar.body: Tell us what you would want from it, and someone who runs it will reply.
pillar.note: Fields and button are not yet wired up — enquiry handling is still to be built. This is an enquiry, not a membership application.

experience.heading: Register interest in this occasion
experience.lead: Places are held for members, and interest is noted ahead of each occasion.
experience.body: Registering interest carries no obligation and is not an application for membership.
experience.note: Fields and button are not yet wired up — registration handling is still to be built. Registering interest is not a membership application.

governance.heading: Ask a governance question
governance.lead: The Trust Framework is being finalised and is not published yet.
governance.body: If you have a question about how the Circle is governed, or would like the framework when it is settled, say so here.
governance.note: Fields and button are not yet wired up. This is not a membership application, and it does not yet reach anyone.

council.heading: Express interest in a council
council.lead: Councils hold their membership across the year, so places open at particular points.
council.body: Tell us which council fits your work and we will let you know when it next takes members.
council.note: Fields and button are not yet wired up — council interest handling is still to be built. This is not a membership application.

briefings.heading: Subscribe to briefings
briefings.lead: Insights are published sparingly, and only when there is something worth the time.
briefings.body: Leave your details and you will receive them as they are written. Nothing else is sent.
briefings.note: Fields and button are not yet wired up — subscription handling is still to be built. This is not a membership application.

enquiry.heading: Enquire about the Circle
enquiry.lead: Questions are welcome, whether or not they lead anywhere.
enquiry.body: Tell us what you would like to know and the right person will reply.
enquiry.note: Fields and button are not yet wired up — enquiry handling is still to be built. This is an enquiry, not a membership application.
